hard_gates.requirement: Every fixed asset resolves by immutable role and SHA-256; no legacy or default fallback is permitted.
Every final Beki is an approved transparent source asset with no redraw, mirror, rotation, warp, or unapproved transformation.
Press cover and digital front/back are derived from the same canonical cover master.
The cover is one continuous world with no visible hinge, spine, panel, turn-in, tint, blur, or guide boundary.
Every story spread is one uninterrupted panorama with no center seam, fold marker, half-page wash, or raster text panel.
Noto story text and all text-support washes are separate vector/layout layers; each wash is local and copy-sized.
Cover and interior page counts and page boxes exactly match the locked millimetre geometry.
Press PDFs are PDF/X-4, contain the locked FOGRA39 Output Intent bytes, and contain no RGB raster object.
Every press raster has at least 300 effective source PPI at placement size; interpolation-only upscaling is a failure.
CMYK conversion preserves authored semantic text colors; credits remain light and readable on the dark background.
Digital front/back are 220 x 200 mm and digital spreads are 440 x 200 mm, with no printer bleed or wrap structures.
Exactly one vector QR appears on credits and scans from the rendered stored artifact to https://beki.ge.
Licensed Noto and Ottia are embedded with no substitution, and source file hashes are recorded.
The stored final artifacts pass both Ghostscript and Poppler render validation.
Every story and fixed page has a final QA record; any unresolved human-review flag blocks release.
The package includes normalized story, visual scenario, asset lock, composition receipts, QA evidence, final checksums, build provenance, and final PDFs.
